scope: Evidence-grounded design/consistency acceptance of the integrated A1-C2 curriculum. Does not open any level, does not certify real-learner efficacy.

deliberatelyDeferredItems.note: prerequisite mapping left to explicit human curriculum-design judgment per LC-AUD-001's own instruction; visibly flagged via unresolvedPrerequisiteNote in c2.json, not silently broken

crossCuttingClaims.claim: Recognition/guided evidence alone never satisfies a required capability; only independent production counts toward mastery.
crossCuttingClaims.condition: May not be described as a directly-proven claim; evidence is inferential/adjacent (general testing-effect and recognition/recall-dissociation literature), not a purpose-built L2 recognition-vs-production study.

crossCuttingClaims.claim: Corrective feedback with retry (not recasts-only) improves L2 outcomes.
crossCuttingClaims.condition: No future PR may standardize the feedback engine on recasts alone; retry/self-repair as default, recasts as one tool among several, matches LC-SUP-001's own P2 calibration precedent.

crossCuttingClaims.claim: Interests/context personalization varies examples only, never the capability standard or mastery threshold.
crossCuttingClaims.confidence: high for the underlying interleaving evidence, scoped not blanket
crossCuttingClaims.condition: check:interest-personalization must remain a permanent, non-removable gate in check:all.

crossCuttingClaims.claim: Motivation/engagement design uses autonomy-competence-relatedness support, no variable-reward or dark-pattern mechanics.
Age-sensitive scaffolding for older adults is L2-pedagogy-evidence-based.
crossCuttingClaims.confidence: low for L2-specific older-adult claims; moderate for general cognitive-aging-informed pacing
crossCuttingClaims.gap: Zero pedagogical-corpus records have an older-adult L2-learner population. Matches limitation already logged in docs/research/supervisors/readiness-report.md.
crossCuttingClaims.requiredChange: Do not market or document older-adult scaffolding as L2-pedagogy-proven; scope claims to 'general accessible-pacing design, L2-specific validation still open', consistent with CLAUDE.md's requirement for later real-learner pilot evidence.

cefrHonestyCheck.note: All six blueprints explicitly exclude listening/speaking/pronunciation/live interpretation from their CEFR claims.

findings.summary: Recognition/guided/independent distinction is a real, load-bearing code path (scaffolding.js:122-144), not documentation-only.

Delayed retrieval is genuinely implemented end to end for C2's multi-capability capstone requirement (blueprints/c2.json coreEngineRequirements[3]) via learnerModel.js's recordDelayedRetrievalEvidence(model, canDoIds), wired live in EpisodeShell.jsx:677-679.
docs/curriculum/blueprints/c2.json's coreEngineRequirements[3] entry is not annotated as resolved, unlike the parallel F8 entries in b2.json/c1.json.
findings.recommendation: A future task with write access to docs/curriculum/blueprints/c2.json should add a 'RESOLVED by LC-INT-001' note.

findings.summary: B1's b1Arc1.js (earlier-authored) distinguishes independent/assisted evidence via suggestionEn presence/absence rather than the explicit evidenceType field A2/B2/C1/C2 use. Functionally sound, less uniform.
findings.recommendation: Future B1 content-alignment pass, not blocking since B1 stays unavailable.

findings.summary: No dark-pattern reward mechanics found in the learning runtime (no Math.random-driven reward code; fixed per-episode XP constants).
